newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT--Dollar set for breakout versus yen.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT--Dollar set for breakout versus yen.

text.p: The dollar is ready for a breakout on the upside versus the Japanese yen as it ended a shortened pre-Christmas holiday session just shy of key resistance at 114.75, analysts said on Tuesday.
If this crucial level is taken out, this may lift the U.S. currency across the board, they also predicted.
The dollar ended on Tuesday at 1.5554/64 marks, 114.42/52 yen and 1.3439/49 Swiss francs.
Currency traders agreed the dollar may be heading for a retest of its 1996 high of 114.92 yen. The year high against the mark was set at 1.5735.
U.S. markets and banks are closed on Wednesday for Christmas. Trading will resume on Thursday.
"Dollar/mark offers some key resistance at 1.5580," said senior analyst Scott Siller at MCM CurrencyWatch.
"We still basically are in that 1.5290-mark to 1.5730-mark range," he added.
Siller remained optimistic that, on the longer term, dollar/mark may advance to the 1.60 level but this would first require a convincing break of strong resistance at 1.5625.
"If we're moving away from 1.5625, we'll go back to 1.5420, the December 16 low," Siller predicted.
The MCM CurrencyWatch analyst was more bullish on the dollar/yen outlook.
"Dollar/yen is gradually progressing to that 114.75 area, which is a two-month consolidation," said Siller, noting the 114.75/80 area is where a bull triangle is coming in at.
"As far as a breakout is concerned, it may come from dollar/yen," added Siller who cited 114.95 yen and 115.90 as the next key resistance levels if a breakout occurs above 114.75.
"This may be something positive for dollar/mark as well," Siller also said.
Analysts pointed out dollar/Swiss is looking very bullish, at least all the way to 1.35.
The next resistance level at 1.3475 is within reach and almost a sure bet in a move in tandem with a dollar/yen breakout through 114.75, they added.
However, since 1.35 Swiss francs would offer the test of a 19-month bull channel, an attack on that level may run out of steam and leave the more dauting 1.3555 level undaunted.
